tagline: Justice goes cross-country this fall, Phase Connect closed the summer convention season under San Antonio stars, and Shanghai got its first holonatsu Paradise window this weekend.
inThisIssue: hololive English -Justice- x Bandai Namco: five-city US popup tour opening in Southern California this September
Phase Connect's OriginS of Stars: Encore! brings five talents to San Japan for Labor Day weekend
BY THE BEAT completes the MERORI bilingual rollout — Japanese MV lands as scheduled on August 25

lead.title: hololive English -Justice- hits the road: Bandai Namco's City Groove five-city US popup tour opens in Costa Mesa this September and runs through spring 2027
lead.body: COVER Corporation and Bandai Namco Amusement America announced on August 27 a five-city US limited-time POP-UP STORE called City Groove, running hololive English -Justice- talent art and merchandise from fall 2026 through March 2027. The tour opens at Mitsuwa Marketplace Costa Mesa on September 20 and runs through October 1, then continues to San Jose's Mitsuwa Marketplace October 6 through November 10, Plano Texas at Mitsuwa November 20 through December 6, Japan Village in Brooklyn December 16 through January 17, 2027, and wraps at Mitsuwa Marketplace Arlington Heights, Illinois from January 23 through March 7. Each stop gets newly commissioned Justice artwork created specifically for City Groove, plus a full lineup of exclusive merchandise: acrylic coasters, panels, and stands, keychains, posters, t-shirts, and tote bags, with individual talent versions across the lineup. The Mitsuwa anchor strategy puts the popup inside Japanese grocery and lifestyle stores with existing fan traffic in four of the five markets. Brooklyn's Japan Village gives the tour an East Coast anchor with a different retail context. Six months, five cities, and the longest sustained US retail footprint for hololive English talent on record — starting in three weeks.

stories.title: BY THE BEAT's MERORI (For Me) Japanese MV lands August 25 — bilingual rollout completes on schedule
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI EN unit BY THE BEAT released the Japanese version MV for MERORI (For Me) at 22:00 JST on August 25, one week after the English MERORI MV dropped on August 19. The two videos use distinct visual treatments for the same single: the English version built around a night pool party with fan mascots, the Japanese version taking a different visual direction entirely. The one-week gap between releases completed exactly as announced and without slipping, which the community has noted as more organized than most dual-release rollouts. Zeal Ginjoka, Freodore, Seible, and Kaelix Debonair now have a two-version single in market and the debate about what the two distinct MVs mean has been running since Tuesday.

stories.title: Phase Connect closes summer convention season with OriginS of Stars: Encore! at San Japan Labor Day weekend
stories.blurb: Phase Connect performed a 3D concert called OriginS of Stars: Encore! at San Japan on August 30 at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in San Antonio, Texas. Lia, Pippa, Tenma, Uruka, and Lumi were the five talents performing. Attendance required only a valid San Japan convention badge — no separate concert ticket. San Japan runs annually over Labor Day weekend. The Encore format makes this Phase Connect's second 3D live of the summer after the OriginS of Stars show at OffKai Expo in San Jose in July, and the closer for Phase Connect's summer 2026 convention run. Including the show with the base badge made it the most accessible Phase Connect 3D live to date.

stories.title: holonatsu Paradise opens in Shanghai today — hololive's first mainland China retail window of the summer
stories.blurb: SUNRISEPOP x hololive production's Late-Summer Mystery Project holonatsu Paradise opened today at Bailian ZX Creative Center on East Nanjing Road in Shanghai's Huangpu District, running through September 9. The pop-up offers acrylic stands, blind-box items, apparel, and exclusive Shanghai edition merchandise. The mystery framing is part of the event identity — what holonatsu Paradise is beyond merchandise is partially a reveal for visitors on the floor. It follows the Taiwan Kenting Travel Diary pop-up in August and the Hong Kong ACGHK holo-tea time collab in July. Three East Asian activations across three distinct markets complete hololive's summer retail tour on the Asia-Pacific side.

stories.title: NIJISANJI EN's Immersion-Focused Male VTuber Audition closes at midnight PDT — shortlist due in approximately one month
stories.blurb: The NIJISANJI EN Immersion-Focused Male VTuber Audition window closed Friday, August 29 at 11:59 PM PDT. Applications are in review and shortlisted candidates will be contacted within approximately one month. This was a separate targeted wave from ANYCOLOR's regular open NIJISANJI EN auditions running since March 2026, with the distinct immersion framing reading as a specific creative direction signal rather than standard talent-spec language. First contact to shortlisted applicants arrives in late September. The debut timeline — if this wave follows standard pipeline — puts a 2027 window as the realistic earliest.

stories.title: Filian: thirteen weeks past the zeroed countdown, DEBUT DELAYED still on the profile, no update
stories.blurb: The Filian VTuber countdown mystery is thirteen weeks past its zeroed date as of today. The filianislost.com domain remains registered. The X account at Filian_VT1 reads DEBUT DELAYED. No Phase 2 trigger, reveal mechanism, or official update has surfaced publicly. The mystery project ran a prominent countdown that expired months ago and the community has worked through theories — interactive unlock, quiet dissolution, deliberate delay — without resolution. Thirteen weeks past a zeroed VTuber countdown has no precedent in the current scene. The only public signal remains the three-word message on the profile.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: Post-VShojo indie tier, one year on: Dokibird, Shylily, Mint Fantome, and Matara Kan anchor a settled top tier
indies.blurb: A year after VShojo's 2025 closure, the English-language independent VTuber field has stabilized. Dokibird, Shylily, Mint Fantome, Akuma Nihmune, Bao, and Matara Kan are consistently cited as the tier-one English independent names in mid-2026 coverage. None are with agencies. All are actively streaming. The talent and audience pipeline that VShojo once organized now runs through individual creator infrastructure — merch, events, and community managed by each talent directly. What was called a transition in 2025 is now the baseline. The indie top tier is not in flux.

indies.title: San Japan stage access: Phase Connect headlined the VTuber stage — the most-watched English independents were not in the building
indies.blurb: Phase Connect's OriginS of Stars: Encore! was the headlining VTuber stage event at San Japan this Labor Day weekend. Dokibird, Shylily, Mint Fantome, and the rest of the English-language independent top tier had no panel or stage presence at the convention. The pattern from Anime NYC two weeks ago repeated: North American convention programming books agency talent, and the independent creators who account for the majority of English VTuber watch time are not on the invite list. Phase Connect is an agency. The most-watched English VTubers are independents. Convention stage time and viewership share are pointing in opposite directions and the gap did not close this summer.

indies.title: August debut wave wraps: multiple English-language indie debuts this month targeted the post-convention viewer reset window
indies.blurb: The August 2026 debut window closes today. Multiple English-language indie VTubers debuted or re-debuted this month, with several specifically targeting late August for the post-convention-season viewer reset: summer convention attendance peaks in August, and debuting as the con circuit wraps positions a new channel in front of audiences settling back into regular streaming schedules. The tactic has become explicit enough that debut-tracking communities discuss it as a named strategy. The class of August 2026 debuts is scattered across YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok with the usual wide range of production levels from first-model solo acts to multi-person coordinated soft launches.

tea.text: Word on /vt/ is that Pippa from Phase Connect has been giving Filian hints on stream, and a video titled 'Filian Joins Phase connect? Pippa gives us Spoilers' is making the rounds. The board is split: half is convinced Filian is Phase Connect-bound and the timing math supports it — filianislost.com still registered, Phase Connect has not announced a replacement after two Saga departures, and October is the Saga anniversary. The other half says this is deliberate Pippa misdirection because she runs parasocial bits as content and does this kind of thing for fun. Nothing is confirmed. The X account still reads DEBUT DELAYED and the domain is still up. Week thirteen and the Phase Connect theory is now the leading community contender.

The rumor mill says the NIJISANJI EN immersion audition wave has a complete character concept already designed and the open call is casting talent toward a pre-built persona rather than discovering the direction post-hire. The argument: the audition language was unusually specific — 'performing as a male character with depth' — in a way that most NIJISANJI EN auditions are not, and similar pointed language preceded an earlier wave that debuted with notable lore integration. Counter-argument: this is projecting too much onto standard audition copy. Nobody outside Anycolor's office knows which read is correct. The debate does not resolve until the wave debuts, which is months out at minimum.

The BY THE BEAT MERORI two-MV debate has not died since Tuesday. The English MV put fan mascots at a night pool party. The Japanese MV (For Me) went a visually distinct direction. /vt/ spent Wednesday and Thursday cataloguing every difference and is now debating whether making two distinct MVs for one single — each implicitly addressing a different audience — is a considered creative strategy or a commercial calculation. The thread got moderated after it turned into a general argument about whether NIJISANJI EN writes songs for their actual audience or for the JP market. BY THE BEAT has not weighed in. The English MV is at a higher view count. Both camps agree that's the only data point that matters and disagree entirely on what it means.

Phase Saga turns one in October and /vt/ anniversary theories are starting early. Two members graduated citing management disagreements, four remain active, Phase Con 2026 in June passed without a new wave announcement, and the countdown to October is eight weeks. Leading theory: Phase Connect marks it quietly with a themed stream week for the remaining four. Secondary thread: the agency drops a surprise wave at or just before the anniversary to reset the gen's narrative. Third camp: Phase Connect's public silence on the topic is itself the answer and the anniversary will pass without acknowledgment. The running joke in all three threads is that the most active member of Phase Saga right now is the speculation that Filian is about to join it.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 7 September — holonatsu Paradise in Shanghai closes September 9, the Sunright Tea boba collab runs its final stretch on the West Coast, the NIJISANJI EN immersion audition shortlist clock is ticking, and Filian_VT1 is still reading DEBUT DELAYED. See you in seven.
